results.question: What are the total sales for each top-level category, counting the sales of its sub-categories too? Sales is the sum of quantity times unit price from order items. Show the top-level category name and the total sales.

results.question: What percentage of delivered orders had at least one returned item? Round to 2 decimal places.
results.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * CAST(returned_cnt AS DECIMAL) / total_cnt, 2) AS percentage FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE has_return) AS returned_cnt FROM (SELECT o.order_id, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_items AS oi JOIN returns AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS has_return FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'delivered') AS sub) AS result
results.agent_answer: 12.98% of delivered orders had at least one returned item.

results.question: How many customers have a total of paid payments that is above the average customer total? Only count payments with a status of paid, and average over customers who have at least one paid payment.
results.generated_sql: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_above_average FROM per_customer WHERE total_paid > (SELECT AVG(total_paid) FROM per_customer)
